title: Goal: Agent-friendly Slack CLI enhancement
description: Enhance slackers CLI with missing features that make it more useful for AI agents and humans. Includes channel discovery, file operations, enhanced search, user experience improvements, and workspace management. Success = agents can fully autonomously interact with Slack workspaces.

title: Goal: Build slackers - Full-parity Rust clone of agent-slack
description: Complete Rust CLI tool (slackers) that replicates all functionality of the TypeScript agent-slack tool. Supports multi-workspace auth (standard tokens + browser xoxc/xoxd), reading/writing messages, search, canvas fetching, user lookups, macOS credential extraction, and JSON output. Reference source: ~/code/experiments/agent-slack/src/. Config at ~/.config/slackers/.

title: Channel Creation & Invite
description: Port `channel new` and `channel invite` from upstream agent-slack. Two new subcommands under the existing `channel` command.

title: Mentions & Notifications
description: Enable agents to list @mentions and unread notifications. Agents monitoring mentions can respond proactively. Includes filtering by channel and date range.

title: Human-Readable Output Formats
description: Add --format table|markdown|plain and --no-json for human-friendly output. Makes debugging and human usage much easier while preserving JSON as default for agents. Include pretty-printed messages with timestamps and usernames.

title: Enhanced Message Listing & Filtering
description: Add pagination, filtering, and time-range queries to message listing. Agents need to efficiently scan channel history without downloading everything. Includes --limit, --before-ts, --after-ts, filter by user, has:link, has:file.

title: File Upload & Management
description: Enable agents to upload files, delete files, and share content with initial comments. Essential for agents that generate reports, logs, screenshots, or code snippets. Currently agents can only download, not upload.

title: Channel Discovery & Management
description: Enable agents to discover, list, and manage channels without prior knowledge. Includes listing all channels, getting channel info, joining/leaving channels, and listing conversations. Critical for agent autonomy - agents can't interact with channels they don't know exist.

title: Canvas + User Commands
description: Canvas: parse canvas URL (docs/T.../F...), files.info, download HTML, extract main/article/body, convert to Markdown via html2md, truncate to --max-chars (default 20000). Users: paginate users.list, filter bots, get by ID or handle, CompactSlackUser struct.

title: Target Parsing + Channel Resolution
description: Parse Slack message URLs into SlackMessageRef (workspace_url, channel_id, message_ts, thread_ts_hint, truncation detection). Channel resolution: is_channel_id regex, normalize_channel_input, resolve_channel_id via paginated conversations.list.

title: macOS Auth Extraction
description: Desktop extraction: find Slack data dir, snapshot LevelDB (cp -cR), scan for localConfig_v2/v3, parse team objects with xoxc- tokens, extract d cookie from SQLite Cookies DB with Chromium decryption. Chrome extraction: osascript to query Chrome tabs for cookies and localStorage. cURL parsing: regex extract workspace URL, xoxd cookie, xoxc token from stdin.

title: Content Rendering
description: Block rendering: section, rich_text (recursive), actions, context, image blocks to mrkdwn. Mrkdwn-to-Markdown conversion with regex replacements (links, channels, users, mentions, HTML entities, emoji shortcodes). Legacy attachment rendering. Emoji normalization with emojis crate.

title: Message Commands
description: Message get/list/send/react handlers. fetch_message with fallback chain (conversations.history > thread scan > thread root). fetch_thread with pagination. CompactSlackMessage construction. File enrichment via files.info. File download with auth headers and caching. Auto-refresh on auth error.

title: Search Commands
description: Search query building with modifiers (after/before/from/in). Two search paths: API (search.messages/search.files) when no channel filter, conversations.history/files.list fallback with client-side filtering when channel specified. Content type filter (any|text|image|snippet|file). Defaults: limit=20, max_content_chars=4000.

title: Auth Resolver + Slack API Client
description: Auth resolver with priority chain: env var > stored credential > default workspace > desktop extract > chrome extract > error. SlackClient with standard token and browser token modes, 429 retry logic, ok-field checking. Output module with prune_empty and to_json_output (2-space pretty-print).

title: Auth Commands
description: All auth subcommands: whoami, test, add, set-default, remove, import-desktop, import-chrome, parse-curl. Token redaction utility. Validate token types on add. import-desktop/import-chrome/parse-curl depend on Phase 6 extraction modules.

title: Config + Auth Types + Store
description: Config paths (~/.config/slackers/credentials.json, ~/.slackers/tmp/downloads/, cache/leveldb-snapshots/). Credential types mirroring auth/schema.ts: Credentials, Workspace, WorkspaceAuth enum (Standard/Browser). Store operations: load/save/upsert/remove/resolve credentials. Keychain integration via macOS security CLI with __KEYCHAIN__ placeholder pattern.

title: Implement message get command
description: Parse target (URL or channel), resolve auth + channel. Fetch message via fetch_message. Get thread summary (reply count, participants). Download attached files. Output JSON via to_json_output. Auto-refresh on auth error: if not env auth and error is invalid_auth/token_expired, try desktop refresh and retry once.

title: Implement file download in slack/files.rs
description: download_file(client, file_info: &Value) -> Result<PathBuf>. Download to ~/.slackers/tmp/downloads/. Auth headers: standard -> Authorization: Bearer {token}, browser -> Bearer {xoxc} + Cookie: d={xoxd} + Referer. Skip if cached (file exists at path). Sanitize filename (remove special chars). Reject HTML responses (indicates auth failure). File enrichment: call files.info for snippets or files missing download URL.

title: Implement message fetching in slack/messages.rs
description: fetch_message(client, ref: &SlackMessageRef) -> Result<Value>: conversations.history with latest=ts, inclusive=true, limit=5, find exact ts match. Fallback: scan thread via conversations.replies. Fallback: try as thread root. fetch_thread(client, channel_id, thread_ts) -> Result<Vec<Value>>: paginate conversations.replies, sort chronologically. to_compact_message(msg: &Value, options) -> CompactSlackMessage: render content via render module, truncate to max_chars, build compact struct with ts, user, text, thread_ts, reply_count, reactions, files.

title: Create render/mod.rs module structure
description: Create src/render/mod.rs re-exporting blocks, mrkdwn, attachments submodules. Primary public API: render_message_content from blocks.rs.

title: Implement attachment rendering in render/attachments.rs
description: Process legacy Slack attachments. For each attachment: render blocks within attachment, pretext, title (with title_link), text, fields (name: value pairs), fallback. Concatenate non-empty parts with newlines. Used as fallback when message has no blocks.

title: Implement block rendering in render/blocks.rs
description: render_message_content(msg: &Value) -> String: try msg.blocks first, then attachments, then text fallback. Block types: section (text + fields + accessory button), rich_text (recursive), actions (buttons), context (elements), image (URL). Rich text elements: rich_text_section (inline), rich_text_preformatted (code block), rich_text_quote (> prefix), rich_text_list (ordered/bullet with indent). Inline elements: text (with bold/italic/strike/code style flags), link, emoji, user, channel. Output Slack mrkdwn format, then pass through mrkdwn converter.

title: Implement mrkdwn-to-Markdown conversion in render/mrkdwn.rs
description: Regex replacements in order: 1) <URL|label> -> [label](URL), 2) <URL> -> URL, 3) <#C123|name> -> #name, 4) <@U123|name> -> @name / <@U123> -> @U123, 5) <!here> -> @here / <!channel> -> @channel / <!everyone> -> @everyone, 6) HTML entities: < > &, 7) emoji shortcodes -> Unicode via emojis crate. Process line-by-line to preserve structure.

title: Implement emoji normalization in slack/emoji.rs
description: normalize_reaction_name(input: &str) -> String: accept :rocket:, rocket, or Unicode char. Strip colons, lookup via emojis crate. emoji_to_shortcode and shortcode_to_unicode helpers. Used by message react commands and mrkdwn rendering.

title: Wire import-desktop, import-chrome, parse-curl to extraction modules
description: Replace Phase 4 stubs in auth/commands.rs: import-desktop calls desktop::extract_workspaces, upserts all found. import-chrome calls chrome::extract_workspaces, upserts all found. parse-curl calls curl::parse_curl_stdin, upserts single workspace. All print confirmation with count of workspaces imported.

title: Implement cURL parsing in auth/curl.rs
description: Read cURL command text from stdin. Regex extract: workspace URL (https://*.slack.com), d=xoxd-... cookie from -H 'cookie:' or --cookie header, xoxc-... token from request body or -d flag. Return parsed Workspace with Browser auth. Error if required fields not found.

title: Implement Chrome extraction in auth/chrome.rs
description: macOS only. Use osascript to query Chrome. Cookie script: find Slack tab, execute JS to extract document.cookie d= value. Teams script: execute JS to read localStorage.localConfig_v2/v3, extract team objects. Parse JSON output, filter for xoxc- tokens. Return Vec<Workspace>.

title: Implement Slack Desktop extraction in auth/desktop.rs
description: find_slack_data_dir(): ~/Library/Application Support/Slack/ or MAS container. Snapshot LevelDB dir via cp -cR to cache dir. Use leveldb scanner to find localConfig_v2/v3 keys. Parse value: handle leading byte prefix, try UTF-8/UTF-16LE, extract JSON. Extract team objects: { url, name, token } where token starts with xoxc-. Extract d cookie from SQLite Cookies DB: SELECT encrypted_value FROM cookies WHERE name='d' AND host_key LIKE '%slack.com'. Decrypt using Chromium pattern: get Safe Storage password from Keychain ('security find-generic-password -w -s Slack Safe Storage'), PBKDF2 + AES-128-CBC decryption.

title: Implement pure-Rust LevelDB scanner in util/leveldb.rs
description: Minimal LevelDB reader for key-value scanning. Parse .ldb/.sst table files (data blocks with restart points) and .log files. Use snap crate for Snappy decompression of data blocks. Only need to scan for keys matching localConfig_v2/localConfig_v3. Return Vec<(key, value)> matches. No full LevelDB implementation needed.

title: Implement channel resolution in slack/channels.rs
description: is_channel_id(input: &str) -> bool: regex ^[CDG][A-Z0-9]{8,}$. normalize_channel_input(input) -> ChannelInput { kind: Id|Name, value }. resolve_channel_id(client, input) -> Result<String>: if already ID return it, else paginate conversations.list (types=public_channel,private_channel), match by name (strip leading #). Return error if not found.

title: Implement target URL parsing in target.rs
description: Parse Slack message URLs: https://*.slack.com/archives/{channel_id}/p{digits}?thread_ts=... MsgTarget enum: Url(SlackMessageRef) | Channel(String). SlackMessageRef: workspace_url, channel_id, message_ts, thread_ts_hint, raw, possibly_truncated. p{digits} -> split at len-6: {seconds}.{micros}. Truncation: has thread_ts param but no cid param. Handle bare channel names and IDs as MsgTarget::Channel.

title: Stub auth import-desktop, import-chrome, parse-curl commands
description: Create handler stubs that return clear error: 'Not yet implemented - requires macOS extraction modules (Phase 6)'. These will be completed when Phase 6 extraction modules are ready.

title: Implement auth set-default and remove commands
description: set-default: accept workspace URL arg, call set_default_workspace, save, confirm. remove: accept workspace URL arg, remove_workspace (clear default if removed was default), save, confirm.

title: Implement auth add command
description: Accept --workspace-url (required), --token OR (--xoxc + --xoxd). Validate: token starts with xoxb-/xoxp- for standard, xoxc- for browser. Upsert workspace into store. Print confirmation with redacted credentials.

title: Implement auth test command
description: Resolve auth (via resolver), call auth.test API, output full response JSON. Verifies credentials are working.

title: Implement auth whoami command
description: Load credentials, redact all tokens/cookies, output JSON with workspace list showing: workspace_url, workspace_name, auth_type, redacted token. Show default workspace indicator.

title: Implement token redaction in util/redact.rs
description: redact_secret(value: &str, keep_start: usize, keep_end: usize) -> String. Default keep_start=6, keep_end=4. Replace middle with '***'. Short values get fully redacted. Used by auth whoami to display credentials safely.

title: Create slack/mod.rs module structure
description: Create src/slack/mod.rs re-exporting client submodule. Will grow as more slack/ modules are added in later phases.

title: Implement output.rs JSON pruning and formatting
description: prune_empty(Value) -> Value: recursively remove null values, empty strings, empty arrays, empty objects from serde_json::Value tree. to_json_output<T: Serialize>(value: &T) -> String: serialize to Value, prune, pretty-print with 2-space indent. Used for all CLI output.

title: Implement SlackClient in slack/client.rs
description: Struct: SlackClient { http: reqwest::Client, auth: WorkspaceAuth, workspace_url: Option<String> }. Method api_call(&self, method: &str, params: Vec<(String,String)>) -> Result<Value>. Standard token: POST https://slack.com/api/{method}, Authorization: Bearer {token}, form body. Browser token: POST {workspace_url}/api/{method}, Cookie: d={url_encode(xoxd)}, Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded, Origin: https://app.slack.com, body includes token={xoxc} + params. Retry on 429: parse Retry-After header, sleep min(header_val, 30)s, max 3 retries. Check ok:true in response, return SlackApiError on failure.

title: Implement auth resolver in auth/resolver.rs
description: Priority chain: 1) SLACK_TOKEN env var (+ SLACK_COOKIE_D/SLACK_COOKIE if xoxc), 2) stored credential by workspace URL, 3) default workspace from credentials, 4) auto-extract from Slack Desktop (macOS), 5) fallback Chrome extraction (macOS), 6) error with helpful message. Returns ResolvedAuth { auth: WorkspaceAuth, workspace_url: Option<String> }. Steps 4-5 initially return error (implemented in Phase 6).

title: Implement credential store in auth/store.rs
description: Functions: load_credentials (read file, deserialize, hydrate from keychain), save_credentials (dehydrate to keychain, serialize, write). upsert_workspace (match by normalized URL, update or append). upsert_workspaces (batch). set_default_workspace, remove_workspace (clear default if removed). resolve_workspace_for_url, resolve_default_workspace. All normalize URLs before comparison.

title: Implement macOS Keychain integration in auth/keychain.rs
description: Shell out to macOS 'security' CLI. keychain_get(account, service) -> Option<String>: 'security find-generic-password -w -a {account} -s {service}'. keychain_set(account, value, service): 'security add-generic-password -U -a {account} -s {service} -w {value}'. On save: store tokens in Keychain, write __KEYCHAIN__ placeholder to JSON. On load: detect __KEYCHAIN__ placeholder, hydrate from Keychain. Service name: 'slackers'.

title: Create auth/mod.rs module structure
description: Create src/auth/mod.rs re-exporting types, store, keychain submodules. Ensure all public types are accessible from auth::.

title: Implement config.rs with path helpers
description: Config paths using dirs crate: credentials_path() -> ~/.config/slackers/credentials.json, downloads_dir() -> ~/.slackers/tmp/downloads/, leveldb_cache_dir() -> ~/.config/slackers/cache/leveldb-snapshots/. Create dirs on first access. ensure_parent_dir helper.

title: Define credential types in auth/types.rs
description: Serde structs: Credentials { version: u32, updated_at: Option<String>, default_workspace_url: Option<String>, workspaces: Vec<Workspace> }. Workspace { workspace_url, workspace_name, team_id, team_domain, auth: WorkspaceAuth }. WorkspaceAuth enum with serde tag=auth_type: Standard { token }, Browser { xoxc_token, xoxd_cookie }. Add normalize_workspace_url fn: extract {protocol}//{host}.

title: Initialize Cargo project with all dependencies
description: Create Cargo.toml with: clap (derive), tokio (full), reqwest (json), serde (derive), serde_json, anyhow, thiserror, regex, url, dirs, chrono (serde), emojis, rusqlite (bundled), html2md, snap, urlencoding. Binary name: slackers, edition 2021.

title: Define clap CLI structs in cli.rs
description: All clap derive structs for: auth (whoami|test|add|set-default|remove|import-desktop|import-chrome|parse-curl), message (get|list|send|react{add|remove}), search (all|messages|files with shared SearchArgs), canvas (get), user (list|get). Include all flags and options from the TS implementation.

title: Create error types in error.rs
description: Define thiserror error enum covering: SlackApiError (error field from API), AuthError (no credentials, invalid auth, token expired), ConfigError (file I/O), ParseError (URL/target parsing), HttpError (reqwest errors). Implement From conversions for anyhow integration.

title: Create main.rs entry point with clap dispatch
description: Entry point: #[tokio::main], parse CLI args, match on command enum, call dispatch in commands/mod.rs. Stub all command handlers to print 'not implemented' for now.

title: Create commands/mod.rs dispatch skeleton
description: Top-level dispatch function matching on Command enum. Each arm calls the appropriate handler module (message, search, canvas, user, auth). All handlers are initially stubs returning Ok(()).

title: Return sent message metadata
description: Make `message send` return `ts`, `channel_id`, and `permalink` instead of just `{ok: true}`.
close_reason: SUMMARY: Updated handle_message_send to call chat.getPermalink after posting and output {ok, ts, channel, permalink}. Permalink fetch is best-effort (silently returns null on failure). AC: met.. FILES: src/commands/message.rs. CONTEXT: 35%

title: Export & Archival
description: Export full channel history in json, csv, or html formats. Useful for backups, analysis, and migration. Supports channel-level exports.

title: Batch Operations
description: Send same message to multiple channels, react to multiple messages with same emoji. Agent-friendly for bulk operations and notifications.

title: Advanced Search Features
description: Add sort options (relevance, timestamp) and advanced filters matching Slack search syntax (has:link, has:emoji, from:me). Enhances search precision for both agents and humans.

title: Workspace Metadata
description: Get workspace info (name, domain, settings) and list custom emojis. Useful for workspace context and for selecting valid emojis for reactions.
